description: This file implements the SharedBuffer class and its nested Semaphore class, providing synchronization primitives and shared buffer management for inter-process communication within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class managing a shared memory buffer with synchronization mechanisms for producer-consumer scenarios.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore
classes.description: A class encapsulating semaphore operations for cross-platform synchronization.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore::Semaphore
methods.description: Constructor initializing semaphore on Windows or with provided sem_t* on POSIX.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Releases the semaphore, increasing its count.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore::IsLocked
methods.description: Checks if the semaphore is currently locked.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore::Lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the semaphore with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::SharedBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing shared buffer with a name.

methods.name: SharedBuffer::SharedBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing shared buffer with name, mode, size, and administrator size.
